title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
summary: 本課以荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘為入口，深入潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設海灣有效面積80 km²、潮差2 m，棱體AΔh=160 million m³；若完全混合且交換率0.3，等效新水為48 million m³，不含河流。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective bay area 80 km² and tidal range 2 m: AΔh=160 million m³. With complete mixing and exchange efficiency 0.3, effective new water is 48 million m³, excluding rivers. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開口流速與收縮」與「潮稜體與生態交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Opening velocity and contraction" and "Tidal prism and ecological exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開口流速與收縮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Opening velocity and contraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開口流速與收縮」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Opening velocity and contraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。斷面平均速度不是閘緣噴流速度，動壓與紊流剪應力又隨速度平方變化。比較同一流量的不同開口，才能看見縮窄後的海床代價。 假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。 局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。潮向翻轉會把危險區換邊，因此只有單向測線無法確認完整保護範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開口流速與收縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents. Section-mean velocity differs from the gate-edge jet. Dynamic pressure and turbulent stresses depend on velocity squared, so comparing openings at fixed discharge reveals the seabed consequences of contraction. Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. A narrow fast jet crossing an unprotected joint may erode the bed despite an acceptable average velocity. Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Opening velocity and contraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開口流速與收縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Opening velocity and contraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開口流速與收縮
knowledge.text: 保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。斷面平均速度不是閘緣噴流速度，動壓與紊流剪應力又隨速度平方變化。
knowledge.textEn: Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents. Section-mean velocity differs from the gate-edge jet.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開口流速與收縮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Opening velocity and contraction" is correct?
options: 開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。
保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。
潮汐交換體積大就能保證每個灣角都迅速換水。
optionsEn: Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour.
Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents.
A large tidal prism guarantees rapid renewal in every bay corner.
quiz.explanation: 保留潮汐交換需要流通面積，但墩柱壓縮通道使局部速度上升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserving tidal exchange requires flow area, while piers contract the channels and accelerate local currents. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開口流速與收縮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Opening velocity and contraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開口流速與收縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Opening velocity and contraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume discharge 6000 m³/s and effective area 3000 m²: Q/A=2 m/s. Reducing area by twenty percent gives 2.5 m/s. This compares quasi-steady sections and excludes recirculation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate acoustic velocity profiles at matched tidal phases and compare section discharge with the water-level difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總流量6000 m³/s、有效開口3000 m²，平均流速Q/A=2 m/s；局部面積減20%則為2.5 m/s。只比較準穩定斷面，不模擬迴流。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開口流速與收縮」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Opening velocity and contraction", which statement holds?
options: 反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。
基底算出拉力時仍可直接沿用全接觸線性壓力式。

steps.title: 開口流速與收縮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Opening velocity and contraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開口流速與收縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Opening velocity and contraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。以收縮前後斷面重複量測檢查連續方程的閉合，量化遺漏側向流的大小。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate acoustic velocity profiles at matched tidal phases and compare section discharge with the water-level difference. Add gate-edge transects instead of treating a central point as the entire contracted flow field. Repeat upstream and downstream transects to close continuity and quantify any omitted lateral flow contribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以開口流速與收縮編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把聲學流速剖面按同一潮相積分，核對斷面流量與上下游水位差；另取閘緣測線，避免以河道中央的單點值代表整個收縮流場。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for opening velocity and contraction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate acoustic velocity profiles at matched tidal phases and compare section discharge with the water-level difference. Add gate-edge transects instead of treating a central point as the entire contracted flow field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A narrow fast jet crossing an unprotected joint may erode the bed despite an acceptable average velocity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 開口流速與收縮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Opening velocity and contraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開口流速與收縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Opening velocity and contraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部高速帶若穿過未保護接縫，平均流速正常仍可能淘空床層。潮向翻轉會把危險區換邊，因此只有單向測線無法確認完整保護範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tidal reversal moves the vulnerable side, so one-direction transects cannot establish the full protection footprint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 雙側水壓合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential hydrostatic gate force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙側水壓合力」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential hydrostatic gate force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘門承受兩側壓力之差，兩邊都濕潤時不能只畫上游三角形。合力大小與作用點分別決定傳遞到支承的剪力及彎矩；潮位反轉時也必須檢查相反方向的接觸與止水。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。 測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。若忽略波浪瞬時吸力或門體變形，靜水合力相符仍不能證明焊縫與導輪安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙側水壓合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. Resultant magnitude and elevation determine support shear and moment. Reversing the tide also reverses contact and seal demands. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences. A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. Ignoring transient wave suction or gate deformation means agreement with hydrostatic force cannot demonstrate weld or guide-wheel adequacy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential hydrostatic gate force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙側水壓合力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential hydrostatic gate force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙側水壓合力

knowledge.textEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. Resultant magnitude and elevation determine support shear and moment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙側水壓合力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential hydrostatic gate force" is correct?
options: 閘門承受兩側壓力之差，兩邊都濕潤時不能只畫上游三角形。
兩側都有水時，只用上游水壓就能得到淨荷載。
反濾料越粗越厚就一定越能阻止基土流失。
optionsEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet.
Upstream pressure alone gives net loading even when both sides are wet.
Coarser and thicker filter material always prevents more base-soil loss.
quiz.explanation: 閘門承受兩側壓力之差，兩邊都濕潤時不能只畫上游三角形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gate carries the difference between pressures on its two sides, so a single upstream triangle is insufficient when both sides are wet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙側水壓合力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential hydrostatic gate force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙側水壓合力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential hydrostatic gate force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設直立矩形板寬10 m，兩側水深6及4 m，同密度淡水且靜止；F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN，不含波浪或海水密度差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume a vertical rectangular plate ten metres wide, still fresh water depths 6 and 4 m: F=ρgb(h1²−h2²)/2=981 kN, excluding waves and seawater density differences. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別繪出兩側壓力圖後相減，再對底部積分求彎矩；將水位計的共同基準與閘門幾何測量交叉核對，不能用壓差單值猜合力作用點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot both pressure diagrams, subtract them and integrate moments about the base.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 雙側水壓合力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential hydrostatic gate force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙側水壓合力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential hydrostatic gate force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別繪出兩側壓力圖後相減，再對底部積分求彎矩；將水位計的共同基準與閘門幾何測量交叉核對，不能用壓差單值猜合力作用點。檢查壓力積分同時滿足合力及力矩平衡，並對水位基準偏差作敏感度分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：測站基準差會造成虛假淨水頭，導致支承反力估計偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A gauge datum mismatch creates false net head and shifts inferred reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 反濾層顆粒保持：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter particle retention: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾層顆粒保持」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter particle retention” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 護床石下方的細土不能被水流穿過大孔隙帶走，反濾層須同時保持基土並讓水排出。單一粒徑比例只是初步篩選；廣級配、分散性與流向反轉需要材料試驗，不能靠增厚大石代替細部相容。 假設基土d85=0.5 mm、反濾料D15=1.8 mm，保持比D15/d85=3.6；只作粒徑比較，不宣稱適用所有土類的驗收門檻。 粗料看似排水良好卻可能放走細土，過細反濾層則會堵塞並增加上浮水壓。若只檢查料場樣品，現場離析形成的薄弱帶可能完全漏判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾層顆粒保持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fine foundation soil must not migrate through voids beneath armor. Filters must retain the base soil while allowing drainage. A grain-size ratio is only screening evidence; broad grading, dispersivity and flow reversal require material testing rather than simply placing thicker large rock. Assume base-soil d85=0.5 mm and filter D15=1.8 mm. Their retention ratio is 3.6, a grading comparison rather than an acceptance limit applicable to every soil. Coarse material may drain freely while losing soil; an overly fine filter can clog and raise uplift. Stockpile-only testing can entirely miss weak bands produced by segregation during placement. steps.title: 潮位滯後與上浮：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「潮位滯後與上浮」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal lag and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮水變化傳入地基孔隙需要時間，因此外部低潮不保證墩底孔壓也低。排水路徑與滲透率決定壓力滯後，必須用同時刻的外水位與基底壓力計算有效重量。靜態最高水位包絡未必捕捉最差組合。 假設墩底面積200 m²、平均超額孔壓25 kPa，附加上浮U=ΔuA=5000 kN；均勻孔壓為簡化，不含沿底面相位差。 排水堵塞可能先表現為退潮後孔壓消散變慢，而不是最大讀數突然增高。只看每日峰值會錯過有效重量最低的短暫階段，掩蓋滑動敏感期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮位滯後與上浮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tidal changes take time to propagate through foundation pores, so low external water does not ensure low pressure beneath a pier. Drainage paths and permeability control lag. Effective weight requires simultaneous external and basal pressures, not unrelated maximum-level envelopes. Assume base area 200 m² and mean excess pore pressure 25 kPa. Additional uplift U=ΔuA=5000 kN. Uniform pressure is assumed, excluding phase differences across the base. Drainage blockage may first appear as slower dissipation after ebb rather than a higher peak reading. Daily maxima alone miss brief minimum-effective-weight periods and conceal increased sliding sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal lag and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 重力主導自由水面的試驗需保持弗勞德數，速度和時間按長度平方根縮放。黏性與表面張力通常不能同時滿足相似，所以模型中的薄水層與小顆粒運動可能失真，量測結果必須附尺度限制。 假設原型與模型長度比25:1，模型流速0.4 m/s；原型速度為0.4√25=2 m/s，模型60 s對應原型300 s；僅適用重力相似。 把模型砂直接按幾何比例替換，可能改變黏聚性與起動機制。即使水面曲線相似，沖刷深度仍可能受到顆粒尺度效應支配，不能只靠影片判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弗勞德縮尺相似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests preserve Froude number, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio 25:1 and model velocity 0.4 m/s. Prototype velocity is 0.4√25=2 m/s; model 60 s represents 300 s, under gravity similarity only. Geometrically scaling sand can change cohesion and the initiation mechanism. Even similar water-surface curves may accompany scale-dependent scour depths, so visual similarity alone is not adequate validation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude model similarity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: A protective decision must accommodate information, assessment and mechanical response before hazardous water arrives. Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Forecast bias and time margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
